tasks.short: Prepare publication format and send the signed work.

steps.what: Prepare the work in the appropriate publication format
Check that the format did not change the words
Send the signed work to publishers or producers
outputs: filed copy of signed formatted work v1

tasks.design: A job prepares the completed work in the appropriate publication format in {DOCS}. The writer checks that the words did not change, signs that version, and a job sends it to publishers or producers. An earlier signature does not cover this formatted version. The job does not write the work.
tasks.previous_blocker: A formatted file could be sent with a line the writer had not approved in that version.
tasks.enabler_now: A template can apply a format the publisher already specified.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the words survived the format is still the writer's check.
tasks.human_edge: The writer signs the version that is sent.

ambition.what: Send the formatted work in the publisher's window, and only after this version is signed.

tasks.altitude: The check and the signature stay. Applying the template and the send shrink.

reach.task: Open only the signed formatted work

evidence.claim: Digest [S12] says public-interest text made by a model needs a label unless a person reviews it under editorial responsibility, and digest [S13] applies that from 2 August 2026, so the writer reviews and signs before a send.
The media digest says creative writing stays manual.

assumptions: Configure the template before custom code.
Nothing is sent before this version is signed.
unknowns: Who else must approve a public text.
research_questions: How often the template breaks a line the writer needs.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the check is the reading itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the term list or the format template when it changes, and clear any draft the writer rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the writer still reads every formatted page. The high end assumes only a format that changes a word comes back. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research facts from accounts, diaries, and interviews.

steps.what: List facts from stored newspaper accounts and diaries

loop.purpose: List factual points only from newspaper accounts or diaries the writer has stored.
loop.input: The writer's question and the stored source rows.
loop.output: Notes in which each point cites a row id.
loop.check: Every point matches the stored row it cites, and no quotation is added.
loop.stop: Stop when a point has no row, or when the question needs an interview.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot tell which stored account answers the question.

steps.what: Obtain the authentic detail the notes support

outputs: filed copy of signed research note v1

tasks.design: The writer conducts the interviews. A bounded draft lists factual information only from newspaper accounts and diaries stored in {DOCS}. The writer obtains the authentic detail those notes support, signs the research note, and a job files that version. A point with no row is dropped. Interview text is not mined. A stored text with a machine-readable opt-out is not used.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated detail could invent a fact or a quotation.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored accounts can be cited without a new archive.
tasks.still_hard: What is authentic, and what an interview meant, is still the writer's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The writer signs the detail they will use.
tasks.altitude: The interviews and the judgement stay. Citing a stored row shrinks.

reach.task: Trust only the signed research note

evidence.claim: The media digest says each fact in a draft must trace to a source.
Digest [S20] records that an editor was suspended after invented quotes appeared in blog posts, so this design adds no quotation that is not in the writer's notes.
Digest [S21] records that 45% of news answers from assistants had a significant issue, so a fact with no source row is dropped.

Digest [S19] says text and data mining is allowed unless the maker opted out in a machine-readable way, so a stored text with that opt-out is not mined, and the copyright procedure stays with the writer.

assumptions: The draft is not the research.
Nothing is filed as a fact before signature.
Interview notes are not sent to a model.
unknowns: Which archives the writer may store.
research_questions: How often a stored account disagrees with an interview.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the interviews is the conversation itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the term list or the format template when it changes, and clear any draft the writer rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every fact is still checked against a row or an interview note. The high end assumes only a point with no row comes back. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with clients, editors, publishers, and producers.

steps.what: Confer with clients, editors, and publishers
Discuss changes or revisions with producers
Sign the conference note on the written material

outputs: filed copy of signed conference note v1

tasks.design: Conferring with clients, editors, publishers, or producers about changes or revisions to the written material stays with the writer. A job files the note in {DOCS} only after the writer signs it. The meeting is not recorded, and the job does not agree a change.
tasks.previous_blocker: A note could record a change nobody had agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can be filed after the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: What to change is decided in the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The writer holds the conference and signs what was asked.
tasks.altitude: The conference stays. Filing the signed note shrinks.

evidence.claim: The media digest says creative writing stays manual.
Digest [S16] says the journalism guideline rejects output tracking, and digest [S17] says that tracking needs works-council consent, so this design does not record how the writer works.

assumptions: The meeting is not tracked as output.
research_questions: How often a request arrives after the meeting.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the conference is the meeting itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the term list or the format template when it changes, and clear any draft the writer rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every conference still happens with the writer. The high end assumes only the signed note is no longer retyped. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan outlines and organize the material.

steps.what: Organize the material to match the outline

outputs: filed copy of signed outline v1

tasks.design: Planning project arrangements and outlines, and organizing the material accordingly, stays with the writer in {DOCS}. A job files the outline only after the writer signs it. No model plans the piece.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated outline could order material the writer had not chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed outline can be filed before drafting.
tasks.still_hard: The order of the material is still the writer's.
tasks.human_edge: The writer plans the outline and signs it.
tasks.altitude: The planning stays. Filing the signed outline shrinks.

evidence.claim: The media digest says creative writing stays manual.

assumptions: The job does not plan or organize the material.
unknowns: Which arrangements a publisher already requires.
research_questions: How often the outline changes after the first draft.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the outline is the planning itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the term list or the format template when it changes, and clear any draft the writer rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the outline is still written by the writer. The high end assumes only the signed outline is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The writer spends the week on the work itself. A format check and sending a signed text can move. No model writes the fiction, the poem, or the lyric.
reach: A publisher receives only the text the writer signed.
A composer hears lyric changes from the writer, not from a generated line.
skills_to_grow: Reject a sentence that adds a fact or a quotation with no source row.
Keep the copyright steps, the reading, and the class as their own work.
role.ambitious_version: A signed text can go to a publisher the same week, and the writer still signs that version.
